old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a glass of beer already filled. The beer is a golden color, indicating it might be a lager or pale ale. A frothy head is visible at the top of the glass, showcasing the carbonation. The background is dark, which makes the golden hue of the beer stand out prominently. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on the glass. There are no other objects or characters present in the frame, keeping the viewer's attention solely on the beer. The lighting highlights the texture of the foam and the clarity of the liquid.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a glass of beer being poured into a pint glass. The beer is a golden color, indicating it might be a lager or pale ale. As the pour continues, a frothy head forms at the top of the glass, showcasing the carbonation and the drink's freshness. The background is dark, which makes the golden hue of the beer stand out prominently. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on the glass and the pouring action. There are no other objects or characters present in the frame, keeping the viewer's attention solely on the beer being poured. The lighting highlights the texture of the foam and the clarity of the liquid, emphasizing the refreshing nature of the beverage.
caption: The video captures a close-up of a curved, footed glass holding a golden, carbonated liquid topped by a white foamy head, set against a dark backdrop with a reddish reflective tabletop at the left. A thin vertical stream of liquid descends into the glass from the top center, indicating the pour is already underway and continues throughout the excerpt. Within the amber body, countless small bubbles rise and shift, altering the internal sparkle pattern. The foam crown at the rim keeps its presence while its surface texture subtly churns and settles. The overall liquid level remains near the top of the frame, showing no large rise or fall. Bright highlights trace the glass's curved walls and thick base, which hold their positions. The scene presents a sustained, ongoing fill rather than a beginning or an ending.
